opening.comment: The greeting does not clearly give the agent's own name or the company name (Tidewell); it is garbled and only a single word is given.

verification.quote: Can I of your full name and order number or postboard?
verification.comment: The agent asked for the full name and order number before discussing the order, which is correct, and the caller provided both before any order data was shared.

understanding.quote: Agent: Thank your, Ahmed. I can see the return of a mirror at €75.00.
understanding.comment: The agent identified the return and the refund issue without re-asking for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds take 10 to 40 working days after we receive the so it'll be another week or too.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving at the warehouse, so the 10 to 40 day timeline and the 'another week' statement are wrong; the agent also quoted an incorrect refund amount of €15.00 against a €75.00 return.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the day is paid.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so permission and thanks were not required, and no damaged-item, bank dispute or goodwill step applied; the requirements that did apply were met.

communication.quote: Agent: I understand, it's worrying when money is outstandin.
communication.comment: The agent acknowledged the caller's worry politely, and the tone was courteous throughout.

closing.quote: Agent: Is they're anything else I can help you which?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else, but did not clearly confirm what happens next beyond an unclear email reference, and the closing line was garbled.
